rules.name: ROOTED IN THE COMMUNITY
rules.text: [Blight] added in your lands does not Destroy your [Presence] if [Dahan] are present. (Ravage Actions Destroy [Dahan] before added [Blight] destroys [Presence] and cascades.)
rules.turn:
add-blight L, spirit:special S rooted, has-presence S L, land:count L dahan C, gt C 0,
  presence-of S X, at X L, { move X destroyed => }
rules.evidence: core-hearth.t: with Dahan alive only River's p1 is destroyed (move p1 destroyed), all Hearth Presence survive; without Fortify, Dahan die first (kill-dahan l1 1) and then move h1 destroyed. Against unmodified core.t, h1 survives in l1 although its Dahan was killed: kill-dahan and add-blight are concurrent siblings there.
rules.notes: The rule's parenthetical fixes an order the base leaves concurrent: core Ravage launches damage-land and damage-dahan as siblings, so the guard 'Dahan are present' read at add-blight start cannot see the Ravage's Dahan kills. core-hearth.t sequences damage-dahan before damage-land (one-line change). The exception filters on this spirit's own Presence by intercepting `move X destroyed` for X bound in the context (other spirits' Presence still destroyed).

rules.name: FORTIFY HEART AND HEARTH
rules.text: [Dahan] have +4 Health (each) while in your lands. Event and Blight Card Actions don't damage, destroy, or replace [Dahan] in your lands. (Ravages are not Event Actions even if caused by Events.)
rules.turn:
-- "Dahan have +4 Health (each) while in your lands."
spirit:special S fortify, has-presence S L / dahan-health L 4
-- "Event and Blight Card Actions don't damage, destroy, or replace Dahan in
--  your lands."
event-action E, spirit:special S fortify, has-presence S L, at V L, piece:kind V dahan,
  { destroy V => }
blight-card-action E, spirit:special S fortify, has-presence S L, at V L, piece:kind V dahan,
  { destroy V => }
rules.evidence: kill-dahan l1 0 and kill-dahan l2 0 with 3 and 5 Damage (Health 6); the Event's event-destroy fires but no Dahan in l2 is destroyed (3 Dahan in l2 at report). Without Fortify: event destroys *295 and Ravage kills Dahan.
rules.notes: core.t hard-coded 'every 2 Damage destroys one Dahan' (half D N); +4 Health needs Health as a summable quantity, so core-hearth.t adds `#acc dahan-health : land @sum` with base row 2 and divides by it; the spirit then adds a 4 row (pure addition). Health is per land, not per Dahan (fine while all Dahan in a land share the bonus). Events/Blight Cards don't exist in core; a minimal event-action episode was added as BASE-EXT. 'damage' and 'replace' by Events are not modeled (no per-piece damage or replace in core).

rules.name: LOYAL GUARDIAN
rules.text: When all [Dahan] leave one of your lands, your [Presence] may Move with those [Dahan] . (Each [Dahan] can Bring any number of [Presence] .)
rules.turn:
move V To, piece:kind V dahan, at V From, land From, neq From To,
  land:count From dahan 1, spirit:special S loyal, has-presence S From
  ~loyal-follow S From To
-- "(Each Dahan can Bring any number of Presence.)" -- one yes/no per Presence
loyal-follow S From To, presence-of S P, at P From
  ?[rng] Y
  !(yes-no Y)
  ~loyal-answer P To Y
loyal-answer P To Y, is Y yes, ~move P To
rules.evidence: Slow-phase push of l1's only Dahan to l2: loyal-follow hearth l1 l2, loyal-answer h1 l2 ..., move h1 l2; report shows h1 in l2.
rules.notes: 'All Dahan leave' is approximated as 'the last Dahan in the land moves' (read via land:count at the move's start). Several Dahan moved by one action (Gather/Push up to N) are not grouped, so 'each Dahan can bring Presence' to different destinations is only per-move. Needs neq (#js-def) to exclude moves within a land.

base_ext: Event Actions as an `event-action E` episode (an event that destroys 1 Dahan in a land). core-hearth.t variant: Dahan Health as #acc dahan-health (@sum, base 2) and Ravage damaging Dahan before the land.
core_diff:
--- core.t	2026-10-09 12:33:29.216961840 -0700
+++ core-hearth.t	2026-10-09 13:09:04.188397132 -0700
@@ -106,8 +106,8 @@
 invaders-deal-damage L
   ~>tally L
   invader-damage L Raw, defend-total L Def, minus Raw Def D0, pos D0 D
+  ~>damage-dahan L D
   ~damage-land L D
-  ~damage-dahan L D
 tally L, ^tallied
 
 -- "1. Invaders Damage the Land: If 2 or more Damage is dealt, add a Blight
@@ -115,7 +115,11 @@
 damage-land L D, ge D 2, ~add-blight L
 
 -- "2. Invaders Fight the Dahan: Every 2 points of Damage destroys one Dahan."
-damage-dahan L D, half D N, ~kill-dahan L N
+#js-def div +A +B -C { yield [Math.floor(A / B)] }
+-- p16 "Each Dahan has 2 Health" (Health exposed as a summable quantity)
+#acc dahan-health : land @sum
+land L / dahan-health L 2
+damage-dahan L D, dahan-health L H, div D H N, ~kill-dahan L N
 kill-dahan L N, gt N 0, land:count L dahan C, gt C 0
   ?[rng] V
   !(at V L, piece:kind V dahan)
language_issues: Sibling sub-episodes launched with plain `~a, ~b` from one rule body are concurrent, so a guard in b-triggered rules cannot see a's effects; ordering must be written into the base with `~>` (here: damage-dahan before damage-land).
Hard-coded arithmetic in base rules (half D N) blocks additive modifiers; quantities like Health must be @sum relations from the start.

Exceptions cannot filter on 'whose' a choice-based destroy is (destroy-presence carries an opaque choice term), so the exception intercepts the downstream `move X destroyed` with X bound in the context instead.
'When all X leave' needs grouping by action; Turn has no notion of an action boundary to aggregate moves over, so the trigger is per-move.
